review:
Smokey as a counterfeit Zeus – the game that introduced the Mystery Reveal. Mystery symbols land vertically on reels 2 to 5 and reveal high symbols, wilds or a Mystery Reel, and wins made with revealed symbols trigger sticky respins.

Mystery Reels hold coins and diamonds as instant prizes, clovers that multiply them, and Pots of Gold that gather it all into one total. All three bonuses give eight free spins, up to Gods Just Wanna Have Fun. 20,000x max.
